mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (user_id, product_id, rating, comment) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{rating}, #{comment})
mapper.select:
SELECT r.id, r.user_id AS userId, r.product_id AS productId, u.name AS userName, r.rating, r.comment, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt
FROM reviews r
JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id
WHERE r.product_id = #{productId}
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(rating), 0) AS averageRating, COUNT(*) AS reviewCount FROM reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId}
